probe_detail.name: Names the specific prior approach it improves on and how
Use of the Oxford (serial) comma in lists
States a concrete limitation or scope condition of its own claim

final.name: Interpretability with intervention
final.audit_justification: Whether interpretability findings drive an actual intervention or correction is a substantive methodological quality about the content of the work.

final.name: Extent of currently fashionable subfield vocabulary
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a raw density-of-buzzword measure disclaimed as not a quality judgment, a fashionable-vocabulary/topic marker with no causal tie to genuine quality.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Trend/hype-keyword density

final.name: Fine-Grained Sub-Component Routing
final.audit_justification: Rewards a specific technique choice (fine-grained routing vs monolithic processing) regardless of whether it works better, so it is a subject-matter/technique marker, though genuine engineering sophistication could underlie both the choice and real quality.
final.arbiter_reason: As written the instruction scores the presence of one architectural technique family (fine-grained routing/mixing between sub-components) versus monolithic processing, with no clause about whether the mechanism is justified, works, or is evaluated, so a high score is a topic/technique marker rather than evidence about research quality. It is mixed because the engineering sophistication and problem framing that lead authors to such mechanisms can also plausibly produce genuinely better papers.

final.name: Mechanistic Explanation of Phenomena
final.audit_justification: Distinguishing causal/mechanistic explanation from mere empirical demonstration is a genuine craft-and-content quality judgment.

final.name: Evaluation-breadth signaling
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores enumeration breadth only, not adequacy or persuasiveness, so it is a resource/coverage marker, though genuinely more thorough labs could produce both breadth and real quality.

final.name: Formalism and theorem density
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores amount of formal notation only, not rigor or value, making it a subfield/style marker; doing genuine theoretical work is a plausible shared cause of both notation density and real quality.

final.name: Claim-matched evaluation breadth
final.audit_justification: Judging whether evaluation breadth actually matches the scope of the claims is a genuine methodological-rigor assessment of the content.

final.name: Extent of formal notation and mathematical vocabulary
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a raw notational-vocabulary density count disclaimed as not judging rigor or correctness, so it is a stylistic/subfield marker with a plausible partial genuine-quality cause (real theoretical work).
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Formalism density

final.name: Order-of-Magnitude Practical Breakthrough
final.audit_justification: Scoring the magnitude of a described practical improvement (order-of-magnitude vs incremental) is judging the substance of the empirical claim, akin to significance-of-result criteria.

final.name: Proof-backed guarantee paired with empirical check
final.audit_justification: Whether a formal guarantee is paired with matching empirical validation is a genuine methodological-rigor property of the work.

final.name: Adversary realism and adaptivity
final.audit_justification: Realism and adaptivity of an adversarial evaluation is a substantive rigor judgment about the content of the work.

final.name: Named large-scale computing infrastructure or hardware mentions
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores presence/specificity of named branded infrastructure only, not necessity or resulting quality, a resource/production fingerprint; access to large compute could also genuinely improve results.

final.name: Explicit Code Repository Links
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores mere presence of a code-repository mention, not code quality or usefulness, a boilerplate/template marker; a genuine reproducibility culture could underlie both open-sourcing and real quality.

final.name: Failure-case transparency
final.audit_justification: Identifying failure modes and how they are detected or mitigated is a genuine transparency-and-rigor quality of the content.

final.name: Regime change versus percentage delta
final.audit_justification: Distinguishing a change-in-kind result from an ordinary percentage improvement is a substantive judgment about the significance of the contribution.

final.name: Problem Reframing Power
final.audit_justification: Whether a paper reconceptualizes a known problem in a genuinely new way is a core conceptual-contribution quality judgment.

final.name: Method acronym branding
final.audit_justification: Density of coined acronyms/branding is explicitly disclaimed from judging whether the naming is good, a pure promotional/style marker unrelated to research substance.

final.name: Checkable conditional claim: conditions named, consequence named
final.audit_justification: Whether the abstract states a checkable conditional claim with named conditions and consequence is a genuine specificity-and-falsifiability quality of the content.

final.name: Abstract verbosity
final.audit_justification: Raw word/sentence count is explicitly listed as a length/verbosity marker disclaimed from judging whether the length is good, with no clear shared cause producing genuine quality.

final.name: Names a specific difficulty and states what it changes
final.audit_justification: Whether a concrete difficulty is named along with what specifically changes is a genuine specificity-of-contribution quality judgment.

final.name: Constraint-native design
final.audit_justification: Whether a real practical constraint actually shapes every major design choice is a substantive methodological-coherence quality judgment.

final.name: Count of enumerated evaluation settings and resource markers
final.audit_justification: Explicitly counts enumerated settings/resource markers only, disclaiming adequacy or informativeness, a coverage/resource fingerprint; genuinely more extensive research effort could also yield real quality.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Evaluation breadth

final.name: Minimal-intervention leverage
final.audit_justification: Whether a minimal, well-specified intervention addresses a major limitation without a large bespoke stack is a genuine elegance-and-efficiency quality of the method.

final.name: Evidence described is matched to the claim's stated scope
final.audit_justification: Judging whether the described evidence is actually matched to and informative about the stated claim is a genuine evidentiary-rigor quality judgment.

final.name: Density of quantified benchmark results in text
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores surface density of numerals/figures only, disclaiming whether they are impressive or credible, a reporting-style marker; more extensive genuine experimentation could also produce more quantified results.
